title: Final Netherite
description: Adds final equipment for Enhanced Netherite, combining the abilities of all Netherite gear.
body:
# Mod Description
Adds final equipment for Enhanced Netherite, combining the abilities of all Netherite gear.
 

**Final Netherite**
 
![终极](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/46de0d3f1d92a02a888a003c4db89b7423d2b2bd.gif)

Final Netherite possesses all the abilities of

**Ender Netherite**

**Feather Netherite**

**Fire Netherite**

**Gold Netherite**

**Phantom Netherite**

**Poison Netherite**

**Water Netherite**

**Wither Netherite**
 

 
## Note: 
This mod requires Enhanced Netherite version 1.2.0 or above.
